spec_match.rationale: Assembles the explainer's exact report shape: an array envelope of {type:"performance-observer", age, url, user_agent, body.entries} with Content-Type application/reports+json, PerformanceNavigationTiming milestone fields as in the example payload, marks carrying detail verbatim, visibility-state entries named visible/hidden, and the terminal {name:"session-end-event", entryType:"session-end", duration:0} — all field names cross-checked against the explainer and content/browser/declarative_performance_observer/declarative_performance_observer.cc.

interactive.rationale: Entry-type checkboxes and an editable include-user-timing allowlist reshape the payload; two mark buttons emit real marks (one allowlisted with detail, one excluded); build assembles from the real timeline. Headless verification with autorun: status read 'Built from the real timeline: 1 navigation, 0 LCP, 1 of 2 marks (allowlist dropped 1), 1 visibility-state, + 1 synthesised session-end entry' and the payload contained real navigation milestone numbers while third-party-noise was absent from it.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the exact payload assembled from this page's real timeline with allowlist filtering and the terminal session-end entry; delivered verbatim.

edge_cases.rationale: Allowlist exclusion is demonstrated with a real non-allowlisted mark; visibility-state degrades with an explicit 'type unsupported in this browser' note; LCP honestly reads 0 when no observer-visible candidate was captured; the real-vs-modelled banner states that the envelope and session-end entry are page-assembled because the true report only exists at browser-process session termination.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6594955352080384, the explainer report-format anchor, and the Reporting API serialization section.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; the payload pre is text-black/bg-ivory (AA) with its own scroll and max-height; buttons set background and color together; fieldsets match the house panel style.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Desktop verified at 1280 (screenshot read: panels, status line, payload). True-360px measurement initially showed an 8px overflow from an inline JSON code span; fixed with overflow-wrap:anywhere and re-measured clean (scrollWidth 345 == clientWidth) plus a 360-wide screenshot read. Controls are min-height 44px. No physical touch device was available.

guidanceConsulted.query: reliable page lifecycle telemetry beacon visibilitychange pagehide
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Defer session telemetry to lifecycle-robust delivery instead of unload handlers, and account for sessions that never reach unload.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page teaches exactly this: the payload preview is framed around browser-process delivery at tab close/BFCache/crash, and the banner explains why page JS can only preview, never send, the terminal report.

guidanceConsulted.query: initial page visibility state entries performance timeline
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use the performance timeline's visibility-state entries rather than racing visibilitychange listeners for initial state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Visibility data comes exclusively from performance.getEntriesByType("visibility-state") — including the initial 'visible' entry at startTime 0 seen in verification — with no listener-based reconstruction.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for asynchronous state changes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce build/copy results via polite live regions; label all controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: report-status and copy-status are aria-live=polite; checkboxes and the allowlist input have real labels inside fieldsets with legends.

openQuestions.title: LCP shows 0 in headless runs because the buffered LCP observer captured no candidate before build; on interact
openQuestions.detail: LCP shows 0 in headless runs because the buffered LCP observer captured no candidate before build; on interactive desktop Chrome it captures the h1 text block. Consider adding a marked hero image so element-level LCP evidence is more deterministic.

openQuestions.detail: When a real activation environment exists (flag/OT + header-sending server), compare a genuine POSTed report body against this preview to confirm field-level fidelity, then tighten the preview if Chromium's serialisation differs.

summary: Builds the documented application/reports+json payload from the page's genuine timeline with working allowlist filtering and honest real-vs-modelled labelling; verified in headless Chromium at desktop and true-360px widths.
